name: Alert
body:
School divination; Level bard 0, fateshaper 0, inquisitor 0, ranger 0, psychic 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, summoner 0, unchained summoner 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range close (25 feet + 5 feet/two levels)
Target one willing creature/level (maximum eight creatures)
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

All targets of this spell are alerted with a mental alarm at the same, predetermined point in time. The time is chosen by the caster when the spell is cast and it must be within the duration of the spell. Once the alarm is activated, the spell ends.
